# Written by mods/cm_maps/tools/industry_support.py - do not edit by hand.
# Colours are the industries' own, common/industry_types/01_industries.txt.
bcm_industry_support = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.52 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = bcm_ind_best } var:bcm_ind_best = 0 } }
			value = rgb { 40 40 40 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 1 }  # textiles
			value = hsv { 0.95 0.45 0.85 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 2 }  # crafts
			value = hsv { 0.08 0.45 0.55 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 3 }  # arms
			value = hsv { 0.02 0.55 0.55 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 4 }  # luxury
			value = hsv { 0.13 0.60 0.90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 5 }  # paper_goods
			value = hsv { 0.55 0.30 0.90 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 6 }  # furnishings
			value = hsv { 0.07 0.40 0.70 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 7 }  # naval
			value = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.65 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 8 }  # beverages
			value = hsv { 0.85 0.50 0.70 }
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "textiles"
		color = hsv { 0.95 0.45 0.85 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "crafts"
		color = hsv { 0.08 0.45 0.55 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "arms"
		color = hsv { 0.02 0.55 0.55 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "luxury"
		color = hsv { 0.13 0.60 0.90 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "paper_goods"
		color = hsv { 0.55 0.30 0.90 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "furnishings"
		color = hsv { 0.07 0.40 0.70 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "naval"
		color = hsv { 0.58 0.50 0.65 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "beverages"
		color = hsv { 0.85 0.50 0.70 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "bcm_ind_legend_none"
		color = rgb { 40 40 40 }
	}

	tooltip_key = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_WATER
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = bcm_ind_best } var:bcm_ind_best = 0 } }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_NONE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 1 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_TEXTILES
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 2 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_CRAFTS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 3 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_ARMS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 4 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_LUXURY
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 5 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_PAPER_GOODS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 6 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_FURNISHINGS
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 7 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_NAVAL
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:bcm_ind_best = 8 }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_INDUSTRY_SUPPORT_TT_BEVERAGES
		}
	}

	small_map_names = raw_material
	medium_map_names = raw_material
	large_map_names = raw_material

	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location

	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no

	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no

	category = economy
	index = 1

	map_markers = {
		fort_marker = no
		port_marker = no
		unit_marker = no
		combat_marker = no
		combat_imminent_marker = no
		supply_depot_marker = no
		market_marker = no
		toll_marker = no
		dynasty_marker = no
		raw_goods_marker = no
	}

	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = 2

		gradient_alpha_inside = 1
		gradient_alpha_outside = 1
		gradient_width = 0.0375
		gradient_color_mult = 0.9
		edge_width = 0
		edge_sharpness = 0.01
		edge_alpha = 0
		edge_color_mult = 0
		before_lighting_blend = 0.5
		after_lighting_blend = 0.5
	}

	refresh_colors_on_selection_change = no
	color_refresh_counters = { }
}
